ei.title: The Paradox of Wealth and Stress
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Few people will be surprised to hear that poverty tends to create stress: a 2006 study published in the American journal Psychosomatic Medicine, for example, noted that a lower socioeconomic status was associated with higher levels of stress hormones in the body. However, richer economies have their own distinct stresses. The key issue is time pressure. A 1999 study of 31 countries by American psychologist Robert Levine and Canadian psychologist Ara Norenzayan found that wealthier, more industrialized nations had a faster pace of life — which led to a higher standard of living, but at the same time left the population feeling a constant sense of urgency, as well as being more prone to heart disease. In effect, fast-paced productivity creates wealth, but it also leads people to feel time-poor when they lack the time to relax and enjoy themselves.

questions.passage: Few people will be surprised to hear that (A)[poverty / prosperity] tends to create stress: a 2006 study published in the American journal Psychosomatic Medicine, for example, noted that a lower socioeconomic status was associated with (B)[higher / lower] levels of stress hormones in the body. However, richer economies have their own distinct stresses. The key issue is time pressure. A 1999 study of 31 countries by American psychologist Robert Levine and Canadian psychologist Ara Norenzayan found that wealthier, more industrialized nations had a faster pace of life — which led to a higher standard of living, but at the same time left the population feeling a constant sense of (C)[urgency / comfort], as well as being more prone to heart disease. In effect, fast-paced productivity creates wealth, but it also leads people to feel time-poor when they lack the time to relax and enjoy themselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① poverty — higher — urgency: 원문 일치. 빈곤(poverty)이 스트레스를 유발하고, 더 높은(higher) 수준의 스트레스 호르몬, 끊임없는 긴박감(urgency)을 느끼게 한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② prosperity — higher — urgency: (A) prosperity(번영)는 poverty(빈곤)와 반대 의미
❌ ③ poverty — lower — urgency: (B) lower(더 낮은)는 higher(더 높은)의 반의어
❌ ④ poverty — higher — comfort: (C) comfort(안락함)는 urgency(긴박감)와 다른 의미
det.tip: poverty tends to create stress / higher levels of stress hormones / a constant sense of urgency

questions.passage: Few people will be surprised to hear that poverty tends to create (A)[stress / relief]: a 2006 study published in the American journal Psychosomatic Medicine, for example, noted that a lower socioeconomic status was associated with higher levels of stress hormones in the body. However, richer economies have their own distinct stresses. The key issue is time pressure. A 1999 study of 31 countries by American psychologist Robert Levine and Canadian psychologist Ara Norenzayan found that wealthier, more industrialized nations had a (B)[faster / slower] pace of life — which led to a higher standard of living, but at the same time left the population feeling a constant sense of urgency, as well as being more prone to heart disease. In effect, fast-paced productivity creates wealth, but it also leads people to feel (C)[time-poor / time-rich] when they lack the time to relax and enjoy themselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① stress — faster — time-rich: (C) time-rich(시간이 풍부한)는 time-poor(시간이 부족한)의 반의어
❌ ② relief — faster — time-poor: (A) relief(완화)는 stress(스트레스)와 반대 의미
❌ ③ stress — slower — time-poor: (B) slower(더 느린)는 faster(더 빠른)의 반의어
✅ ④ stress — faster — time-poor: 원문 일치. 부유한 경제에도 고유한 스트레스(stress)가 있고, 더 빠른(faster) 생활 속도, 시간 부족(time-poor)을 느끼게 한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: their own distinct stresses / a faster pace of life / feel time-poor

questions.passage: Few people will be surprised to hear that poverty tends to create stress: a 2006 study published in the American journal Psychosomatic Medicine, for example, noted that a lower (A)[socioeconomic / psychological] status was associated with higher levels of stress hormones in the body. However, richer economies have their own distinct stresses. The key issue is time pressure. A 1999 study of 31 countries by American psychologist Robert Levine and Canadian psychologist Ara Norenzayan found that wealthier, more (B)[industrialized / agricultural] nations had a faster pace of life — which led to a higher standard of living, but at the same time left the population feeling a constant sense of urgency, as well as being more prone to heart disease. In effect, fast-paced (C)[productivity / leisure] creates wealth, but it also leads people to feel time-poor when they lack the time to relax and enjoy themselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① psychological — industrialized — productivity: (A) psychological(심리적인)은 socioeconomic(사회경제적인)과 다른 개념
❌ ② socioeconomic — agricultural — productivity: (B) agricultural(농업의)은 industrialized(산업화된)와 반대 개념
❌ ③ socioeconomic — industrialized — leisure: (C) leisure(여가)는 productivity(생산성)와 다른 의미
✅ ④ socioeconomic — industrialized — productivity: 원문 일치. 낮은 사회경제적(socioeconomic) 지위, 더 산업화된(industrialized) 국가, 빠른 속도의 생산성(productivity)이 부를 창출한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: a lower socioeconomic status / more industrialized nations / fast-paced productivity creates wealth

questions.passage: Few people will be surprised to hear that poverty tends to create ①<u>stress</u>: a 2006 study published in the American journal Psychosomatic Medicine, for example, noted that a lower socioeconomic status was ②<u>associated</u> with higher levels of stress hormones in the body. However, richer economies have their own distinct stresses. The key issue is time pressure. A 1999 study of 31 countries by American psychologist Robert Levine and Canadian psychologist Ara Norenzayan found that wealthier, more industrialized nations had a ③<u>slower</u> pace of life — which led to a higher standard of living, but at the same time left the population feeling a constant sense of urgency, as well as being more prone to heart disease. In effect, fast-paced productivity creates ④<u>wealth</u>, but it also leads people to feel time-poor when they lack the time to relax and enjoy themselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 부유한 국가들의 생활 속도가 '더 빠른(faster)' 맥락. slower(더 느린)는 반대 의미
det.analysis:
❌ ① stress — 원문 일치. 빈곤이 스트레스를 유발한다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② associated — 원문 일치. 낮은 사회경제적 지위가 더 높은 스트레스 호르몬과 연관된다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ③ slower — 원문은 faster(더 빠른). slower(더 느린)로 바꾸면 '부유한 국가가 더 느린 생활 속도를 가졌다'가 되어 문맥에 모순 ←정답
❌ ④ wealth — 원문 일치. 빠른 생산성이 부(wealth)를 창출한다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: wealthier nations had a faster pace of life — 부유한 국가들은 더 빠른 생활 속도를 가졌다

questions.passage: Few people will be ①<u>surprised</u> to hear that poverty tends to create stress: a 2006 study published in the American journal Psychosomatic Medicine, for example, noted that a lower socioeconomic status was associated with ②<u>lower</u> levels of stress hormones in the body. However, richer economies have their own distinct stresses. The key issue is time pressure. A 1999 study of 31 countries by American psychologist Robert Levine and Canadian psychologist Ara Norenzayan found that ③<u>wealthier</u>, more industrialized nations had a faster pace of life — which led to a higher standard of living, but at the same time left the population feeling a constant sense of urgency, as well as being more ④<u>prone</u> to heart disease. In effect, fast-paced productivity creates wealth, but it also leads people to feel time-poor when they lack the time to relax and enjoy themselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 낮은 사회경제적 지위가 '더 높은(higher)' 스트레스 호르몬과 연관. lower(더 낮은)는 반대 의미
det.analysis:
❌ ① surprised — 원문 일치. 빈곤이 스트레스를 유발한다는 것에 놀라지 않을 것이라는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② lower — 원문은 higher(더 높은). 낮은 사회경제적 지위가 '더 낮은 수준의 스트레스 호르몬'과 연관된다고 하면 빈곤이 스트레스를 유발한다는 전체 맥락과 모순 ←정답
❌ ③ wealthier — 원문 일치. 더 부유한(wealthier) 산업화된 국가들이 더 빠른 생활 속도를 가졌다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ prone — 원문 일치. 심장병에 더 걸리기 쉬운(prone)이라는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: higher levels of stress hormones — 더 높은 수준의 스트레스 호르몬

questions.passage: Few people will be surprised to hear that poverty tends to create stress: a 2006 study published in the American journal Psychosomatic Medicine, for example, noted that a lower socioeconomic status was associated with higher levels of stress hormones in the body. However, richer economies have their own ①<u>distinct</u> stresses. The key issue is time pressure. A 1999 study of 31 countries by American psychologist Robert Levine and Canadian psychologist Ara Norenzayan found that wealthier, more industrialized nations had a faster pace of life — which led to a higher ②<u>standard</u> of living, but at the same time left the population feeling a ③<u>constant</u> sense of urgency, as well as being more prone to heart disease. In effect, fast-paced productivity creates wealth, but it also ④<u>prevents</u> people to feel time-poor when they lack the time to relax and enjoy themselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 빠른 생산성이 부를 '이끌어 낸다(leads)'. prevents(방지하다)는 반대 의미
det.analysis:
❌ ① distinct — 원문 일치. 부유한 경제에 고유한(distinct) 스트레스가 있다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② standard — 원문 일치. 더 높은 생활 수준(standard of living)이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ③ constant — 원문 일치. 끊임없는(constant) 긴박감을 느낀다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ prevents — 원문은 leads. 빠른 생산성이 부를 '방지한다'로 바꾸면 '생산성이 부의 창출을 막는다'가 되어 문맥 모순 ←정답
det.tip: fast-paced productivity creates wealth = leads to wealth creation

❌ ③ resistant: resistant(저항력 있는)은 질병에 걸리기 쉬운 것과 반대 의미

det.analysis:

❌ ③ denied: denied(부인했다)는 언급과 반대되는 행위
❌ ④ questioned: questioned(의문을 제기했다)는 사실 확인이 아닌 의심의 의미

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 leads의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: leads: (A) 고속도로가 공항으로 이어지다 / (B) 사람들이 시간 빈곤을 느끼게 만들다
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) (길이) ~로 이어지다 — (B) ~하게 만들다/유도하다: (A)는 도로가 공항으로 통한다는 물리적 연결, (B)는 생산성이 사람들을 시간 빈곤으로 이끈다는 인과적 유도의 의미 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 이끌다 — (B) (길이) ~로 이어지다: (A)와 (B)의 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (A) (길이) ~로 이어지다 — (B) 선도하다: (B)는 선도가 아닌 인과적 유도
❌ ④ (A) 지휘하다 — (B) 앞서가다: 두 의미 모두 원문 맥락과 불일치
det.tip: lead: ① (길이) ~로 이어지다 ② ~하게 만들다/유도하다 ③ 이끌다/선도하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a feeling of anxious importance or the need to act quickly"

det.korean: urgency=긴박감/급박함 (초조한 중요성이나 빠르게 행동해야 한다는 느낌)
det.analysis:
✅ ① urgency: urgency(긴박감)는 초조한 중요성이나 빠르게 행동해야 한다는 느낌으로 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ② patience: patience(인내)는 급박함과 반대되는 차분한 기다림
❌ ③ harmony: harmony(조화)는 긴박감과 무관한 평화로운 상태
❌ ④ stability: stability(안정성)는 급박한 느낌과 반대되는 안정 상태
det.tip: urgency = 긴박감, 급박함. a sense of urgency = 긴박감

questions.passage: A 2006 study __________ (publish) in the American journal Psychosomatic Medicine noted that a lower socioeconomic status was associated with higher levels of stress hormones in the body.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: study와 publish는 수동 관계(연구가 출판되는 것). 명사 뒤에서 수식하는 과거분사(p.p.)가 필요. publish → published (a study published in = ~에 출판된 연구)
det.tip: 명사 + p.p.: a study published in = ~에 출판된 연구. 수동/완료의 과거분사 후치 수식

questions.passage: In effect, fast-paced __________ (productive) creates wealth, but it also leads people to feel time-poor when they lack the time to relax and enjoy themselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 형용사 fast-paced 뒤에 명사 형태 필요: productive(형용사) → productivity(명사)
det.analysis: fast-paced는 형용사로 뒤에 명사가 와야 주어 역할을 할 수 있다. productive(형용사: 생산적인) → productivity(명사: 생산성). fast-paced productivity creates wealth = 빠른 속도의 생산성이 부를 창출한다
det.tip: productive(형용사) → productivity(명사). 품사 전환: -ive(형용사) → -ivity(명사)

questions.passage: Few people will be surprised to hear that poverty tends to create stress: a 2006 study published in the American journal Psychosomatic Medicine, for example, noted that a lower socioeconomic status was associated with higher levels of stress hormones in the body. However, richer economies have their own distinct stresses. The key issue is __________. A 1999 study of 31 countries by American psychologist Robert Levine and Canadian psychologist Ara Norenzayan found that wealthier, more industrialized nations had a faster pace of life — which led to a higher standard of living, but at the same time left the population feeling a constant sense of urgency, as well as being more prone to heart disease. In effect, fast-paced productivity creates wealth, but it also leads people to feel time-poor when they lack the time to relax and enjoy themselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: time pressure=시간 압박 — 부유한 경제의 핵심 문제는 시간 압박이라는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① social inequality: social inequality(사회적 불평등)는 부유한 경제의 핵심 문제로 제시된 것과 불일치
✅ ② time pressure: 원문 일치. 'The key issue is time pressure'에서 부유한 경제의 핵심 문제가 시간 압박(time pressure)이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ environmental pollution: environmental pollution(환경오염)은 본문에 언급 없음
❌ ④ cultural diversity: cultural diversity(문화적 다양성)는 본문에 언급 없음
det.tip: The key issue is time pressure — 핵심 문제는 시간 압박이다

questions.passage: Few people will be surprised to hear that poverty tends to create stress: a 2006 study published in the American journal Psychosomatic Medicine, for example, noted that a lower socioeconomic status was associated with higher levels of stress hormones in the body. However, richer economies have their own distinct stresses. The key issue is time pressure. A 1999 study of 31 countries by American psychologist Robert Levine and Canadian psychologist Ara Norenzayan found that wealthier, more industrialized nations had a faster pace of life — which led to __________, but at the same time left the population feeling a constant sense of urgency, as well as being more prone to heart disease. In effect, fast-paced productivity creates wealth, but it also leads people to feel time-poor when they lack the time to relax and enjoy themselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a higher standard of living=더 높은 생활 수준 — 빠른 생활 속도가 더 높은 생활 수준으로 이어졌다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① a decline in overall happiness: 전반적 행복 감소는 본문에서 직접 언급되지 않음
✅ ② a higher standard of living: 원문 일치. 'which led to a higher standard of living'에서 빠른 생활 속도가 더 높은 생활 수준(a higher standard of living)으로 이어졌다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ a reduction in working hours: 근무 시간 단축은 본문에 언급 없으며 빠른 속도와 모순
❌ ④ an increase in leisure activities: 여가 활동 증가는 본문의 시간 부족과 모순
det.tip: led to a higher standard of living — 더 높은 생활 수준으로 이어졌다
